chapter.heading: Ecclesiastes 12
Remember Your Creator in Your Youth
chapter.v: you will say, “I have no pleasure in them”;
the sun and the light and the moon and the stars are darkened and the clouds return after the rain,
those who look through the windows are dimmed,
the daughters of song are brought low—
shattered at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern,
The Preacher sought to find words of delight, and uprightly he wrote words of truth.
much study is a weariness of the flesh.
Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of man.
God will bring every deed into judgment, with every secret thing, whether good or evil.

footnotes.footnote: 12:8 The Hebrew term *hebel* can refer to a “vapor” or “mere breath” (three times in this verse); see note on 1:2
